class.name: InstanceField3D
class.brief_description: Many copies of a few meshes over a large area, each drawn at the level of detail its own distance from the viewer falls in.
class.description: Call [method set_bounds], then [method add_type] per kind of copy: one mesh a level, the distance each level ends at, how many of the nearest levels cast shadows, and 8 floats a copy (position, rotation quaternion, uniform scale). Copies are grouped into cells whose side is the smallest power of two times the base cell reaching a share of the level's end distance (a quarter; [code]set_cell_share[/code], before any type is added), one MultiMesh a cell, culled and drawn whole; a level's cells are refilled when the viewer has moved 1 % of its end distance, and a cell's buffer is sent only when its copies changed. Levels that cast no shadows also stay out of Godot-EX's ray-traced scene.
